summary: EF 发布 Checkpoint #9：Glamsterdam 进展慢而稳，ePBS 实现比预期更难；Hegotá 选定 FOCIL 为头号功能，并承诺把账户抽象纳入次要功能。非头号提案开放首日，Amxx 提议 EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE，nconsigny 提议 EIP-7851 与 EIP-8151，让 EIP-7702 委托后的 EOA 可停用原私钥。

items.title: EF 博客：Checkpoint #9
items.note: （Protocol Support Team）：Glamsterdam 进展慢而稳，ePBS 把出块拆成共识内先后行动的两方，协议须处理两方分歧或失败，几乎触及整个技术栈；gas 重定价作为一组优先推进，提高合约大小上限的 EIP-7954 也可能被优先；Hegotá 选定 FOCIL 为头号功能，并承诺把账户抽象作为次要功能之一，非头号 EIP 自 4 月 9 日起可提交。
items.note_en: (Protocol Support Team): Glamsterdam is slow but steady; ePBS splits block production into two parties acting in sequence inside consensus, so the protocol must handle disagreement or failure between them, touching nearly the whole stack; gas repricings are prioritized as a bundle and EIP-7954, raising the contract size limit, is likely prioritized too; Hegotá chose FOCIL as headliner and committed to account abstraction as a minor feature, with non headliner EIPs open from April 9.

summary_en: The EF published Checkpoint #9: Glamsterdam progress is slow but steady with ePBS harder than expected; Hegotá chose FOCIL as its headliner and committed to account abstraction among the minor features. On the first day of non headliner proposals, Amxx proposed EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE and nconsigny proposed EIP-7851 and EIP-8151 to let EIP-7702 delegated EOAs deactivate their original key.
